shared_elements: repeated incised/relief signs or geometric motifs
justification: The strongest correspondence is that both surfaces include stylized human or anthropomorphic imagery combined with repeated signs and circular motifs on a tall vertical decorated form. The biggest difference is that A is dominated by a single highly schematic front-facing body-like figure with broad bands, while B is an ornate composition with a vertical column of many glyph-like elements and separate detailed figures along one side.
